description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, announces that God roars from Zion and will judge Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom and Ammon for their crimes.
1.sw: Amosi, mfugaji wa kondoo kutoka Tekoa, anatangaza kwamba Mungu ananguruma kutoka Sayuni na atahukumu Dameski, Gaza, Tiro, Edomu na Waamoni kwa ajili ya makosa yao.
1.am: ከቴቁሔ የመጣው በግ አርቢው አሞጽ እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን እንደሚያገሣና ደማስቆን፣ ጋዛን፣ ጢሮስን፣ ኤዶምንና አሞናውያንን ስለ በደላቸው እንደሚፈርድባቸው ያውጃል።

2.en: God will judge Moab and Judah, and Israel for selling the righteous for silver and trampling the poor.
2.sw: Mungu atahukumu Moabu na Yuda, na Israeli kwa kuwauza waadilifu kwa fedha na kuwakanyaga maskini.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር በሞዓብና በይሁዳ ላይ፣ ጻድቁን በብር ስለ ሸጡና ድሆችን ስለ ረገጡም በእስራኤል ላይ ይፈርዳል።

3.en: God chose Israel from all the families of the earth, so God will punish them for all their sins.
3.sw: Mungu aliwachagua Israeli kati ya jamaa zote za dunia, kwa hiyo Mungu atawaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao zote.
3.am: እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ከምድር ወገኖች ሁሉ መረጠ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ሁሉ ይቀጣቸዋል።

4.en: The wealthy women of Samaria oppress the poor, and Israel did not return to God despite famine, drought and plague, so they must prepare to meet their God.
4.sw: Wanawake matajiri wa Samaria wanawaonea maskini, na Israeli hawakumrudia Mungu licha ya njaa, ukame na tauni, kwa hiyo lazima wajiandae kukutana na Mungu wao.
4.am: የሰማርያ ሀብታም ሴቶች ድሆችን ይጨቍናሉ፤ እስራኤልም ራብ፣ ድርቅና መቅሠፍት ቢመጣባቸውም ወደ እግዚአብሔር አልተመለሱም፤ ስለዚህ አምላካቸውን ለመገናኘት መዘጋጀት አለባቸው።

5.en: Amos laments for Israel and calls the people to seek God and live, and to let justice roll on like water.
5.sw: Amosi anaomboleza kwa ajili ya Israeli na kuwaita watu wamtafute Mungu waishi, na kuiacha haki itiririke kama maji.
5.am: አሞጽ ለእስራኤል ሙሾ ያወርዳል፤ ሕዝቡም እግዚአብሔርን ፈልገው በሕይወት እንዲኖሩና ፍትሕ እንደ ውኃ እንዲጐርፍ ይጠራቸዋል።

6.en: Woe to those at ease in Zion who lie on beds of ivory but do not grieve over Israel's ruin.
6.sw: Ole wao wanaostarehe katika Sayuni wanaolala juu ya vitanda vilivyonakshiwa kwa pembe za ndovu lakini hawahuzuniki kwa uharibifu wa Israeli.
6.am: በጽዮን ተዝናንተው በዝሆን ጥርስ በተለበጡ አልጋዎች ላይ ለሚተኙ፣ በእስራኤል ጥፋት ግን ለማያዝኑ ወዮላቸው።

7.en: Amos sees visions of locusts, fire and a plumb line. Amaziah the priest tells Amos to go back to Judah, and Amos answers that God called him.
7.sw: Amosi anaona maono ya nzige, moto na timazi. Amazia kuhani anamwambia Amosi arudi Yuda, naye Amosi anajibu kwamba Mungu alimwita.
7.am: አሞጽ የአንበጣ፣ የእሳትና የቱንቢ ራእዮችን ያያል። ካህኑ አሜስያስ አሞጽን ወደ ይሁዳ እንዲመለስ ይነግረዋል፤ አሞጽም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጠራው ይመልሳል።

8.en: A basket of summer fruit means the end has come for Israel. A famine is coming, not of bread, but of hearing the words of God.
8.sw: Kikapu cha matunda ya kiangazi kinamaanisha kwamba mwisho umewafikia Israeli. Njaa inakuja, si ya mkate, bali ya kusikia maneno ya Mungu.
8.am: የበጋ ፍሬ ቅርጫት ፍጻሜው በእስራኤል ላይ እንደ መጣ ያሳያል። የእንጀራ ሳይሆን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የመስማት ራብ ይመጣል።

9.en: God stands by the altar and no one can escape judgment. Yet God will raise up David's fallen shelter and restore the fortunes of Israel.
9.sw: Mungu anasimama karibu na madhabahu na hakuna awezaye kuikwepa hukumu. Lakini Mungu ataisimamisha tena hema ya Daudi iliyoanguka na kuwarudishia Israeli hali yao njema.
9.am: እግዚአብሔር በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሟል፤ ከፍርድም የሚያመልጥ የለም። ሆኖም እግዚአብሔር የወደቀችውን የዳዊትን ድንኳን እንደ ገና ያቆማል፤ የእስራኤልንም ዕድል ፈንታ ይመልሳል።
